verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; the cause is identified and being addressed.
narrative: This period you received 17 leads at an average cost per lead of $98.54 — and the last seven days saw a 60% drop in leads alongside a near-tripling of that cost, with zero leads on $187 spent across the final three days of the week. The drop traces to an efficiency collapse in paid social, compounded by Google Ads spend more than doubling without a proportional return, and your Google Business Profile actions hitting zero for four consecutive days. Heating campaigns and local service ads that were scheduled to be live are being prioritized now to open new lead sources heading into the heating season. You should expect the cost per lead to normalize as those channels activate and the ad creative is refreshed this week.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, with the majority arriving in a single 4-day window
average cost per lead this period, up sharply from the prior 7-day pace
total Google Business Profile actions (calls, directions, site visits) across all three listings this period

watch_item.issue: Zero leads over the last three days of the week despite active spend, and heating campaigns that were due to launch have not yet gone live — a direct gate on seasonal volume.
watch_item.fix: Heating campaigns on both Google and Meta are being activated now, local service ads are being re-enabled, and the two Google Business Profile listings with low call rates are being optimized to convert the impressions they are already receiving.
